skills.description: Create free SSH tunnels to expose local ports to the internet using tinyfi.sh. Use when you need to share a locally running app, test webhooks, demo a prototype, or get a public HTTPS URL for any local service — no signup or authentication required.
skills.description_zh: 使用 tinyfi.sh 创建免费 SSH 隧道，将本地端口暴露到互联网。适用于共享本地运行的应用、测试 webhook、演示原型或为任意本地服务获取公共 HTTPS URL，无需注册或身份验证。
skills.name: tunneling
